{{Top|leg|title=''Dionad''-class transport}}
The '''''Dionad''-class transport''' was a type of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was produced by [[Sadon Shipwrights]].

==History==
''Dionad''-class transports were produced a few years before the start of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and were used by private organizations within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Sadon later developed an updated version of the ''Dionad''-class, the [[Heraklon-class transport|''Heraklon''-class transport]].
